## tmh open

Open the developer docs or the TeachMeHIPAA console in your browser

### Synopsis

Opens a TeachMeHIPAA page in your browser: docs or reference for the Developer API docs, console or dashboard for the console where admins manage API clients. Without a browser, it prints the URL instead.

```
tmh open <console|dashboard|docs|reference> [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for open
```

      --live                     use the "live" profile

      --profile string           profile to use: "sandbox" (default) or "live"
      --show-headers             print each HTTP response's status and headers to stderr
      --verbose                  print method, path, status, latency and request id of each HTTP attempt to stderr
